cues.text: Hello, you have reached the complaints department. How can I help you?
cues.speaker: OPERATOR

cues.text: Yes, hello there. I am phoning to make a complaint regarding a ﬂight that I took with you recently.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: OK. There are some details I will need to take from you ﬁrst. May I have your name please?
cues.speaker: OPERATOR

cues.text: Jack Dawson. That’s D-A-W-S-O-N.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: And your address?
cues.speaker: OPERATOR

cues.text: It’s Hillcrest Road. That’s H-I-double-L-C-R-E-S-T.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: 33  Hillcrest Road. Is that in Exeter?
cues.speaker: OPERATOR

cues.text: Yes.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: And what is the postcode of the residence?
cues.speaker: OPERATOR

cues.text: It’s AL698GQ.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: Thank you. Do you have a telephone number?
cues.speaker: OPERATOR

cues.text: Yes. The number at my office is 754688.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: That’s good, and may I just take a home phone number for you in case of emergencies?
cues.speaker: OPERATOR

cues.text: No problem. It’s 798662.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: Are they both local numbers?
cues.speaker: OPERATOR

cues.text: Yes.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: OK great, thank you for your patience. Now what is the nature of your complaint?
cues.speaker: OPERATOR

cues.text: I’m phoning to complain about a ﬂight I took recently.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: I always take certain measures to ensure that I will be comfortable.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: For example, I always pay the additional cost for extra legroom and I always arrive punctually for the ﬂight to make  sure  that  I  am  seated  beneath  an   air   conditioner.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: Unfortunately   I was disappointed to ﬁnd that the air conditioning on the plane was broken, so I spent the entire flight in discomfort as it was too hot and the air was stuffy.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: I see. I do apologise for this fault with the air conditioning.
cues.speaker: OPERATOR

cues.text: Now while I have you on the phone, would you mind answering a short questionnaire regarding your recent flight?
cues.speaker: OPERATOR

cues.text: Sure.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: OK, let’s get started. What did you think of the food that was served to you during the flight?
cues.speaker: OPERATOR

cues.text: I thought that it was inexpensive and quite delicious.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: However I was still very hungry afterwards as it was a very small portion and more of a snack.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: Providing a snack for lunch is not reasonable.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: OK, I have noted that down.
cues.speaker: OPERATOR

cues.text: What was your opinion of the quality of service that you received from our staff on-board?
cues.speaker: OPERATOR

cues.text: The staﬀ were very helpful, but each time I pressed the button to  request service it took a long time for a staﬀ member to arrive.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: I found this frustrating as there just weren’t enough staﬀ on-board the ﬂight to be able to serve all of the customers.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: OK, that’s great. Thank you very much for answering those questions.
cues.speaker: OPERATOR

cues.text: Are there any other parts of your travel experience that you would like to comment on?
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: Yep. The process of moving through security was very quick and helped to make my travel experience stress-free.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: Okay. Do you have any extra comments on the services you received during the flight?
cues.speaker: OPERATOR

cues.text: Yes, I thought that the seats were very uncomfortable and looked very old.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: They were also in need of repair as the reclined feature on my chair was broken so I could not go to sleep for the whole ﬂight.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: Luckily the entertainment facilities were very good so I was able to distract myself by watching movies.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: Thank you so much for taking the time to answer all of my questions, we would like to oﬀer you some gifts as a goodwill gesture, with a 20% discount on the cost of your hotel stay.
cues.speaker: OPERATOR

cues.text: We also appreciate that international calls to your home country can be expensive and we are sure that you would like  to keep your family updated on your travels, so please accept a phone card, which has a credit of £20.
cues.speaker: OPERATOR

cues.text: Oh that’s really great. Thank you so much for the gifts!
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: No problem, we look forward to having you travel with us again soon! Have a fantastic vacation.
cues.speaker: OPERATOR
